Between runs (21 Oct): draft actions were redrafted so each keeps why its findings were combined and selected, and what each finding contributes (21 actions became 18).
Between runs (21 Oct): actions are ranked by a model against a written spec (pipeline/priority-spec.md) instead of a fixed formula.

runs.title_en: Run 2: the Chinese papers again, then 176 open-access papers

inputs.note_en: Phase A re-read 19 of the first 20 Chinese papers; phase B read the 176 papers with open full text found by the new search (2,005 found, 964 about the fish and a welfare topic).

settings.en: New stage translate, on qwen/qwen3.8-flash: an English rendering beside each Chinese claim, with every number checked.
New stage reconcile: one name per practice. Phase A used qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902; phase B anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5, after the first model cut its answers short.
New stages after the run (12 Oct): cluster and findings on anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 with qwen/qwen3-embedding-8b embeddings; actions on anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5.
Stage suggest retired; draft actions now come from findings.

notes.en: New search across Europe PMC, Crossref, DOAJ, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar, in English and Chinese, with open full text downloaded.

Extraction reads overlapping windows instead of one page per call, so claims across a page break are seen whole; each claim records what was measured versus stated, its direction, limitations and counterevidence.
The source language is the record: Chinese claims stay in Chinese, English is a rendering beside them.
A species store keeps every claim that passed with a permanent id, so later runs add to it instead of starting over.
Three reconcile attempts were cut off before names were sent in batches; their calls are in the log.
